summary.name: DeepAI
summary.one_liner: DeepAI is a browser-based creative AI platform for generating and editing images, creating short videos, composing music, and chatting with AI, with APIs, and it also takes on custom computer vision projects.
use_cases: monitor endangered species from camera trap and aerial imagery
custom computer vision projects for organizations
summary.what_it_does: DeepAI offers browser-based generators for images, photo editing, short videos, and original music, plus an AI chat that browses the internet and a voice chat option. Many features are also available through APIs. Basic use is free without an account, and DeepAI Pro is listed at $9.99 per month with high-volume usage, private generations, and no ads. The page also describes the company's custom technical work for governments, nonprofits, and research groups, including computer vision and satellite imagery projects for conservation and land inventories. Those examples are presented as case studies on the page.
notable: First browser-based text-to-image generator, started late 2016
Image, video, music, and voice chat tools in one platform with APIs
Custom computer vision and sensor projects for conservation and government clients
caveats: DeepAI Pro costs $9.99 per month for high-volume usage, private generations, and an ad-free experience
Custom technical projects are offered to governments, nonprofits, and research organizations; pricing for these is not stated
